name: Fresh Canna | 1g Live Resin Infused RSO Dart | OG Kush
description: Fresh Canna’s OG Kush Live Resin Infused RSO captures the essence of this world-renowned hybrid. The earthy, pine-forward profile is accented with zesty citrus undertones, delivering both a robust flavor and a balanced effect. The infusion of live resin terpenes elevates the full-bodied potency of RSO, creating a product that soothes the body while sharpening the mind. Ideal for those seeking powerful relief with a versatile high, OG Kush delivers strength, depth, and an unmatched classic cannabis experience.
